title: From Activity Recognition to Shift Detection: Variational Wi-Fi Sensing with Evidential Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.24596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human motion perturbs wireless channels, making commodity Wi-Fi devices a practical platform for device-free activity recognition. Yet Channel State Information (CSI) also depends strongly on the person, receiver position, recording session, and surrounding environment, so a classifier can continue producing activity labels after its deployment conditions have moved away from those seen during training. We propose Wi-HAR, a multi-antenna architecture in which four Variational Auto-Encoders learn compact distributions from raw Wi-Fi 6 CSI magnitudes and a delayed-fusion classifier combines their means and log-variances. On twelve activities from a public benchmark, Wi-HAR reaches 96.6% median recognition accuracy, compared with 70.8-81.5% for independently optimized single-antenna models, showing that the antennas provide complementary views of the same activity. translated_title: 从活动识别到漂移检测：基于证据不确定性的变分Wi-Fi感知
translated_abstract: 人体运动会扰动无线信道，这使商用Wi-Fi设备成为无设备活动识别的实用平台。然而，信道状态信息（CSI）也强烈依赖于具体的人、接收器位置、录制会话以及周围环境，因此当部署条件偏离训练时的条件后，分类器仍可能继续输出活动标签。我们提出了Wi-HAR，这是一种多天线架构，其中四个变分自编码器从原始Wi-Fi 6 CSI幅度中学习紧凑分布，并由延迟融合分类器结合它们的均值与对数方差。在一个公开基准的十二个活动上，Wi-HAR达到了96.6%的中位数识别准确率，而经过独立优化的单天线模型仅为70.8–81.5%，这表明多天线为同一活动提供了互补的观测视角。随后，我们利用相同的潜在骨干网络，在不使用（标签）的情况下检测部署条件的漂移。
tldr: 该论文提出Wi-HAR多天线变分自编码器架构，从原始Wi-Fi 6 CSI中学习紧凑分布，在十二类活动识别上达到96.6%的中位数准确率（显著优于单天线模型的70.8–81.5%），并复用同一潜在骨干实现部署条件漂移的检测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Wi-HAR, a multi-antenna architecture of four variational auto-encoders with delayed fusion that achieves 96.6% median accuracy on twelve Wi-Fi 6 CSI activities (vs. 70.8–81.5% for single-antenna models) and reuses the same latent backbone to detect deployment shifts.
